headline: App Development Cost in India (2026): What Drives It and How to Estimate
description: What it costs to build an app in India in 2026: indicative ranges by app type, the India-specific factors that move the price, and how to estimate your own.

itemListElement.name: App Development Cost in India (2026): What Drives It and How to Estimate

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build an app in India in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on scope. Using our method, a lean MVP is about 7 weeks and roughly $13k to $22k, and a market-ready product with payments, an admin dashboard and a custom backend is about 25 weeks and roughly $45k to $80k. These are indicative ranges for a senior team.

mainEntity.name: Why do app development quotes in India vary so much?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vendors assume different scope, team seniority and rates. Ask each for the weeks behind the number and compare against the same written feature list.

mainEntity.name: Does GST apply to app development in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: GST applies to software services billed in India. Confirm the current rate and treatment for your case with your accountant.
UPI and gateway payments, DPDP consent and data handling, RBI requirements for fintech, support for lower-end Android devices and poor networks, and regional languages.

mainEntity.name: How can I estimate my own app?

acceptedAnswer.text: List your features, pick platforms and backend, and put them into the cost calculator for an indicative range. A fixed price follows a short discovery call.
